board-head.title: Leaderboard
board-head.body: Members ranked by the work they do on the desk inside the window, never by returns. A return never enters the score. Everyone sees the top three; QuantGPT Pro opens the whole board.

board-period.title: Daily, weekly, monthly
board-period.body: Daily looks back 1 day, weekly 7 and monthly 30 for forum posts and journal findings.

disc.title: How the score works
disc.body: Each counted item adds to the score as the formula under the table says. No return, worst fall or profit is part of it.
